customers.evidence: reaching customers wherever they are and innovating new tastes and choices, while staying true to customer favorites

employees.evidence: Building on our commitments to our people

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, brand-led tone using first-person plural 'we' and emotive phrases like 'proud' and 'an experience to remember'. Customers are addressed first and most concretely. Other stakeholders appear only as a brief closing reference to 'commitments' that are not specified. No hedging, but also few concrete commitments.
